WITH corning AS (

  FROM cn_4509b5c383744bb6.companies
  WHERE name ILIKE '%Corning%'
  LIMIT 1
)

JOIN cn_4509b5c383744bb6.annual_metrics AS t2022

  ON t2021.ticker = corning.ticker
  AND t2021.metric = 'effective_tax_rate'
